purpose: Static retained scenario inventory for the future attention-router JSON/TOON golden harness.

canonicalization: replace generated message ids and reservation ids with [ID]
replace agent names only when the scenario is not about active ownership
sort unordered source-health and evidence arrays by stable id
summarize command outputs into reason codes and counters
golden_strategy.update_policy: UPDATE_GOLDENS-style updates require human review of the diff and a Beads comment citing the scenario ids changed.

scenarios.title: Empty br ready while bv recommends a blocked RCH issue
scenarios.summary: The router must trust Beads readiness over a stale graph recommendation when `br ready --json` is empty and `bv --robot-next` points at `ft-4tp7g`.

explanation_must_include: br state is authoritative for actionability
bv recommendation is advisory only
ft-4tp7g remains blocked until RCH reaches remote Cargo proof

volatility.strategy: scrub timestamps and active assignee name unless ownership is under test

scenarios.title: RCH degraded with no admissible worker
scenarios.summary: The router must separate source readiness from proof substrate failure when RCH selects no worker and remote Cargo is not reached.

source_fixture_requirements.command_or_api: rch diagnose --json --dry-run -- env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/ft-<bead>-proof cargo test ...

explanation_must_include: remote proof did not reach Cargo or rustc
local Cargo output cannot close a proof lane
static checks may support diagnosis only

volatility.strategy: structural golden with reason-code matching; scrub worker names, slots, queue ids, timestamps, and target dirs

scenarios.title: Ack-required Agent Mail request
scenarios.summary: The router must recommend acknowledging direct communication before starting unrelated work.

explanation_must_include: ack-required messages are work coordination inputs
acknowledgement is a lightweight receipt, not permission to mutate files
Agent Mail repair is forbidden if the service is degraded

volatility.strategy: fixture should use synthetic reduced metadata or scrub sender, message id, and timestamps; do not store full bodies

scenarios.title: Possibly stale in-progress bead
scenarios.summary: The router must recommend a status-check before force-release when a bead appears stale but has incomplete evidence.

explanation_must_include: elapsed time alone is not enough
Codex idle placeholder text is not stuck evidence
broadcast/status-check precedes force-release

volatility.strategy: structural golden over evidence classes and counters; scrub times, agent names, pane ids, and commit shas unless they are the scenario subject

scenarios.title: Dirty tree overlaps active owner paths
scenarios.summary: The router must pause overlapping work and pick a disjoint path when tracked dirty files belong to another active lane.

source_fixture_requirements.command_or_api: file reservation snapshot or reduced Agent Mail metadata
br list --status in_progress --json or br show <bead> --json

explanation_must_include: dirty files in shared checkout are presumed to be another agent's work
do not stash, revert, overwrite, or stage unrelated dirty files
path reservations and Beads ownership bound the safe edit surface

volatility.strategy: canonicalize paths relative to repo root; keep filenames when overlap classification depends on them

scenarios.title: Bead closed locally while publish steps are pending
scenarios.summary: The router must treat local Beads closed state as non-durable until the owning agent commits the closeout, pushes origin/main, and updates the legacy mirror ref.

source_fixture_requirements.command_or_api: git rev-parse HEAD && git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main refs/heads/<legacy-mirror>
fetch_inbox or search_messages for <bead> plus file reservation snapshot

explanation_must_include: local tracker closed state is not durable until committed and pushed
do not stage or commit another agent's closeout
origin/main and the legacy mirror ref must contain the closeout before dependent work is claimable

volatility.strategy: scrub timestamps, message ids, reservation ids, target refs, and commit shas unless the closeout commit is the scenario subject

scenarios.title: Docs-only or fixture-only ready slice while code proof is blocked
scenarios.summary: The router must allow a static docs/fixture task when RCH blocks code proof lanes and the edit surface is disjoint from active dirty work.

source_fixture_requirements.command_or_api: bead proof section plus AGENTS.md RCH policy

explanation_must_include: static/docs fixture work can proceed without remote Cargo
owned paths are disjoint from active dirty work
future code-bearing closeout still requires RCH

volatility.strategy: exact structural golden after scrubbing timestamps and generated Bead ids

must_generate: json golden output for every scenario
toon golden output or documented TOON-equivalent rendering for every scenario
structured decision log explaining source health, evidence, classification, confidence, and safe action
must_fail_when: bv advisory output is treated as claim authority over br status
local Cargo is counted as proof for a proof-required lane
Agent Mail degraded state recommends repair or restart
RCH degraded state recommends service mutation or build cancellation
dirty overlap recommends stashing, reverting, or staging another agent's work
stale-claim detection force-releases without status-check evidence
local closed tracker state is treated as durable before commit and remote publication
future_harness_requirements.proof_policy: RCH-only for Rust/e2e harness execution after code exists; static jq and diff checks are sufficient for this inventory.
